products/: The AeonX SaaS suite on top of SAP. Each product closes a gap a clean S/4HANA leaves open, and each ships with agentic AI inside.
products/axiom/: AXIOM is production AI for SAP operations: new tickets matched to past resolutions, suggested fixes with confidence scores, and 70% of L1 auto-resolved.
products/crm-360/: CRM 360 runs inquiry to quotation to sales order, visits, complaints and a live SAP ledger from WhatsApp or a browser, so field teams actually use it.
products/setu-move/: Setu Move replaces paper slips with one digital journey for bulk material, mine to plant: verified at every checkpoint, weighed, and posted to SAP.
products/quic/: QuiC is enterprise chat that never leaves India: end-to-end encrypted messaging, calls and an assistant that knows your products, hosted in Mumbai.
products/jarvis/: Jarvis is an agent operating system: around thirty-five AI agents across seven functional pods, each with a named human manager.
products/datasetu-ai/: DataSetu.ai puts one API over every SAP edition you run: ten canonical entities, document AI on our own models and a 21-agent library.
products/setuedge/: SetuEdge lets the plant floor report for itself: edge agents on twenty-one industrial protocols, an over-the-air control plane and trusted event feeds.
